recipe.visualDefinition: A three-person band portrait set against concrete stairs, framed by a thick, textured dark brown border with distressed edges. The composition features a primary display title at the top and a secondary title integrated into the photographic area with a weathered, stamped effect.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject depth created by tiered seating on stairs
Textured outer frame containing a clean-edged inner photograph
Contrast between the cool grey concrete and the warm dark brown border
Typographic weight balancing the visual weight of the subjects
coreInvariants: Thick, dark brown textured border with rough inner edges
Concrete stair background providing horizontal linear rhythm

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects arranged in a triangular formation; one in the foreground left, one central, one in the background right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure sitting on the stairs, looking off-camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top display text, down to the central figure, then following the diagonal line of the stairs to the other two members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper third of the frame occupied by the border and primary text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subjects' skin tones and the dark border.

letterConstructionRules: 3D drop-shadow effect on the primary display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Primary text features a subtle inner bevel and a flat 3D extrusion
Secondary text features a distressed, stamped texture with irregular ink bleed

composition.position: Upper left quadrant of the photo area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A clean, extruded display face paired with a gritty, stamped subtitle for textural contrast.
graphicDevices: Rough, hand-painted style inner border mask
Subtle canvas texture on the outer brown frame

preserve: Wide letter spacing of the top text
The distressed texture of the inner text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric skeleton of the top display text.
Provides the necessary weight for the distressed subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of three men sitting on outdoor concrete stairs in casual 2000s-era clothing. The lighting is overcast and natural. Surround the photo with a thick, dark chocolate brown border that has a rough, distressed inner edge as if painted on with a dry brush.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place wide, bold, blue-grey uppercase text at the top center of the brown border with a dark brown 3D drop shadow. Place a two-line, heavy, distressed dark brown title in the upper left area of the concrete stairs, using a stamped or eroded texture.

verificationChecks: Is the border texture visible and dark brown?
Does the top text have a clear 3D extrusion?
Is the inner text distressed and integrated into the photo area?
Are the subjects arranged on concrete stairs?

adjustableVariables: Placement of the secondary text block
mustRedesign: Identifiable faces of the original artists
Exact wording of the original titles

mustAchieve: Balanced use of negative space in the border
avoid: Clean, vector-perfect edges on the border mask

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the inner photo has a 'framed' look with irregular edges.
Check that the 3D shadow on the top text matches the border color.
Verify the secondary text looks like it was stamped onto the concrete.
Confirm the triangular composition of the subjects is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a textured, thick-bordered frame with a tiered environmental portrait and two layers of contrasting sans-serif typography—one clean and extruded, one distressed and integrated.
